title: nan
authors: Deng J.; Liu J.; Hu J.
key_contribution: Presents a tightly coupled air-ground collaborative system with UAV YOLOv8 perception mapping and ground UGV A* path planning for navigation in GPS-denied cluttered environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
